flows.representativeInput: 20/5-day git fixture; round-1 probe rerun; new probes: docs root `.` via CLI, docs root `.docs`, installation.json missing/malformed/wrong shape/listing a doc, symlinks, a submodule, a doc whose only commit is the root commit
flows.expected: age-out --days 14 lists only working docs under the docs root older than 14 days, with count and age; harness files are never listed

observations.actual: 12/12 tests pass. [AC:spec-9-1] lists only docs/research/old.md (20 days). [review-a-2] (moved from a `.` layout to a docs/ layout) still excludes entry, project, mapped and backlog files; [review-9-1] covers the `.` skip, dot segments and installed files.

Round-1 probe rerun: the round-1 failure is fixed. With a docs root of `.` nothing is listed or moved; every harness/tool file stays (.claude, .agents, .joycraft, .github). Probes 1, 2, 4-7 still pass; the backtick #anchor, :line and docs-root-relative spellings, CLAUDE.local.md and the merge-resolution case are now handled. The single failing line, "dot root lists notes/old.md", is obsolete: by design a `.` root now lists nothing.

New probes: `.` root via CLI exits 0 with one skipped entry; installation.json missing, malformed, files-as-object or with a null entry all exit 0 and list normally; a doc that installation.json lists is kept; files inside a submodule are not listed and the gitlink stays; a doc whose only commit is the root commit is listed at 20 days.

Probe B: docs root `.docs` (features/archive/context = .docs/..., accepted by the config validator). age-out exits 0 with count 0, docs [] and skipped [] although .docs/research/old.md is 30 days old. The new dot-segment check runs on the whole path, so every file under a dot-folder docs root is excluded, silently (no skipped entry, unlike the `.` root). Round-1 code listed it.

observations.actual: [AC:spec-9-2] passes: porcelain exactly "R  docs/research/old.md -> docs/archive/working/research/old.md", HEAD unchanged. [review-a-2] dirty/missing/non-ASCII test passes.
Probe 5: staged-only change skipped, an existing target skipped and untouched, a name with a space moves. Probe 3: `.` root apply moves nothing, no commit.
A doc next to a symlink and next to a submodule moves to docs/archive/working/research/. A tracked relative symlink doc is moved with its link text unchanged, so it no longer resolves (follow-up f8).

flows.expected: cleanup.md names age-out in the attended pass; the session-end skill does not

observations.actual: [AC:spec-9-3] passes. The fix only adds "If it prints a `skipped` entry instead, say why and go on." to the attended step (cleanup.md:165).

findings.summary: The fix tests for a dot segment on the whole path (`file.split('/').some(part => part.startsWith('.'))`). With a docs root that is itself a dot folder, such as `.docs` (the config validator accepts it), every file under the docs root is excluded. age-out then exits 0 with docs [] and skipped [], so the attended pass is told there is nothing to archive. Round-1 code listed these docs, so this is a regression from the fix. Reproduced in spec-09-probes-new-r2.log probe B. Fix direction: test dot segments on under(file), the path under the docs root, or return a skipped entry the way the `.` root does.

A docs root of `.` now gives one skipped entry and moves nothing, and cleanup.md:165 tells the agent to say why. The spec and brief do not decide the `.` layout; their acceptance fixtures use docs/. So the skip meets acceptance, and it is the safe reading after round-1 f1. Cost: projects whose paths have no common parent folder (for example context: docs with features: work/features) get no age-out.
findings.assumption: Working docs need a docs folder; the brief defines the docs root as the common parent of the three paths and does not ask for whole-project scans.

findings.summary: [review-a-2] moved from a `.` layout to a docs/ layout. Its reason is round-1 blocking finding f1 (the `.` layout is the defect), not the spec or brief text. No exclusion it checked was removed: entry files, nested AGENTS/CLAUDE, README-like files, mapped pages (table name, link, @-import, ../ link from context) and backlog files are still asserted, now under docs/. The `.` behavior is asserted by the new [review-9-1] test at line 128. This does not weaken the check.
The round-1 probe line "dot root lists notes/old.md" fails by design now that a `.` root is skipped. It is obsolete; every other round-1 probe line passes.
When docs/ is a tracked symlink to another folder, ls-files -- docs lists only the link, so age-out lists nothing and gives no skipped entry (probe D2). Rare; not a regression.

A tracked relative symlink .md under the docs root is listed and git mv moves it with its link text unchanged, so docs/archive/working/research/link.md no longer resolves (probe D1). Rare; one revert undoes it. Not a regression.

Round 2 code is from fix-spec-9 (a0de6175f6687ca9e, 01f909e) on top of lane-a-tidy (ab91b652c1d17b46d) and fix-lane-a; implementerActor records lane-a-tidy as instructed. The test file is already a check input in the subject.
